integrity.note: Cross-checked against the official GP column on nba.com/stats/teams/advanced (Regular Season).

home_court.note: Derived by least squares from the 174 verified results. Not an official NBA statistic.

rows.pair: Home points vs away points (same game)
rows.note: Computed from the 174 verified final scores.
Residuals are out-of-sample (walk-forward). This is the key input for same-game parlays that combine a side with a total.

rows.pair: Cover (vs our spread) AND over (vs our total)
rows.note: Joint hit rate 0.246 vs 0.219 under independence.

rows.pair: Player A points vs Player B points, same team, same game (PTS-PTS)
rows.note: Requires per-player game logs, which were not captured. Left blank by policy.

rows.pair: Player points vs player rebounds, same player, same game
rows.note: Requires per-player game logs. Left blank by policy.

rows.pair: Player points vs player assists, same player, same game (combo SGP)
rows.note: Requires per-player game logs. Left blank by policy.

rows.pair: Two legs in different games (cross-game parlay)
rows.note: Not measured on this sample. Independence is an ASSUMPTION, not a verified result; treat as unverified.

strategies.label: Fade totals of 235+
strategies.rule: When our originated total is 235 or more, take the under.

strategies.label: Back road favourites of 8+
strategies.rule: When our originated spread has the away team favoured by 8 or more, take the away side.

strategies.label: Fade home favourites of 8+
strategies.rule: When our originated spread has the home team favoured by 8 or more, take the away side.

strategies.label: Back totals of 218 or fewer
strategies.rule: When our originated total is 218 or less, take the over.

strategies.label: Rest differential >= 2 days
strategies.rule: When one team has at least two more days of rest than the other, take that team against our originated spread.

strategies.label: Originated spread - home side
strategies.rule: Take the home side against our own originated spread in every rated game (self-consistency test).

strategies.label: Originated total - over
strategies.rule: Take the over against our own originated total in every rated game (self-consistency test).

strategies.label: Same-game parlay: home cover AND over
strategies.rule: Two-leg correlated parlay built on our own originated spread and total.
strategies.note: Two-leg parlay judged against the independence-implied joint rate 0.219, not 0.50 (a 50% null would be a category error here).
